summary: All in-scope claims in the final paper reconcile with scored arrays, raw scored summaries, executed code and locks, and the primary HMoE source. One Full-X scope wording issue was found, corrected by the author, and reverified; its exact counterexamples are preserved.

scope.evidence: Specified scored source JSON and arrays, raw run metadata and seals, source code, locked protocols and configurations, and primary literature.
scope.excluded: Prior reviewer findings, executor interpretive reports, generated numeric_claims.json and verification reports were not used as scientific evidence. AGENTS.md was read only as an operational instruction.
scope.mutations: The auditor wrote only audit reports, calculations, extracted text and PDF previews. The author corrected one wording finding and adjusted standard float placement during this audit; no scientific data or numerical source changed.
scope.layout_finalization: Read final main.tex, including topfraction=0.9 and textfraction=0.1. Extracted all 15 final PDF pages; decimal-number multiset identical to the preceding corrected PDF. Re-rendered and visually inspected final pages 9-14. The all-paid table is now within Results; the corrected Full-X clause is on page 14.

claims.paper_claim: Four development collections, two 384-to-768 migrations, three budgets, six methods and seeds 17/29/41/53/67; prospective TREC has 171,332 documents and 50 queries.
claims.details: Raw index and per-query shapes confirm all queries and five mapping seeds per partial condition. FiQA method selection and the development status of all four collections are explicit in the paper.

claims.paper_claim: b=|A union S|=floor(rho N), anchors included; fixed 1,024 pairs and nested replacement sets; separate all-paid 28,819-pair fits at FiQA 50%.
claims.details: select_for_budget starts with unique anchors and inserts unseen permutation rows to the exact floor count; paid nonanchors are replacement-only in fixed-anchor fits.

claims.paper_claim: Centered rectangular Procrustes and the float64 raw affine B0 preserve the float32 Procrustes means and matrix.
claims.details: Orientation, centering, thin SVD, no intermediate row normalization or fitted scale match code.

claims.paper_claim: N(z)=z/||z||; exactly two lambda=10 norm-scaled negative cosine-gradient targets, with the ridge correction penalty centered on the current affine map.
claims.details: Differentiation and substitution C=Bt+Delta verify the equalities. Intercept regularized; Cholesky reused; float64 accumulation then float32 final coefficients. Fitted corrections need not remain tangent, and the paper makes no finite-step descent guarantee. Positive common-scale equivariance is correctly restricted to exact arithmetic/nonzero predictions.

claims.paper_claim: One affine map plus normalization and exact mixed retrieval; coefficient storage is 1.13 MiB and 114.7 times fewer bytes than the evaluated Converter; declared primal and dual solver complexities.
claims.details: 385*768 = 295,680 coefficients; four bytes each give 1,182,720 bytes or 1.1279296875 MiB. The parameter ratio is 33,927,168/295,680 = 114.74285714285715. Matrix dimensions support the stated complexities. The paper labels storage as structural, separates primal and dual backends, and excludes end-to-end cost or SLO interpretation.

claims.paper_claim: Five declared baseline configurations: LA2M20 with global singleton fallback; five-layer SELU SimpleLinear with final 50 epochs and batch 4,028; regularized-bias ridge at lambda=10; Converter with 50,000 selection updates, batch 64, k=100, MAE checkpoints every 250 updates, earliest minimum and fresh refit.
claims.details: Declared source and lock agree. Baseline adaptations and absence of qrel-based stopping are disclosed, so these are configuration comparisons, not original-paper reproduction claims.

claims.paper_claim: Graded gain 2^rel-1; Recall uses all positives; exact float32 top-100 retrieval with stable row ties and identical-ID exclusion; 20,000 paired query resamples share indices after five-seed averaging, with distinct declared families.

index_digest_checks.note: Only RNG index streams regenerated, not metric bootstrap draws or labels. Shared-index construction separately inspected in executed source.

claims.details: Executed scorer SHA matches B1c/B1M/B1P metadata and B2 lock pins. B1M SeedSequence child per collection shares its index array; B1P recovery imports original summary construction; B1c/B2 pack all method/pair/budget/metric columns into a common bootstrap call. Different analyses legitimately use different RNG streams. No new full metric-bootstrap rerun.

claims.paper_claim: ARC2 has the highest development macro nDCG and positive intervals against all five baselines in the development macro family.
claims.details: Aggregation weights all 24 conditions equally. The six-decimal Procrustes delta 0.024325 and interval [0.018132,0.030792] round correctly. All five adjusted intervals are strictly positive.

claims.paper_claim: ARC2 has 23/24 Procrustes and 24/24 other-baseline point gains; pair-specific macro differences, unresolved Recall difference and the FiQA/E5/75% negative exception are retained.
claims.details: Point counts are distinct from family-supported macro comparisons, as paper states.

claims.details: All five exact deltas and intervals reconcile. Zero-step and ridge interval endpoints differ slightly between the separate B1M and B1c families because their bootstrap streams and families differ; the paper uses the correct saved family for each. Lambda=1 is unresolved, lambda=100 is negative, and no independent confirmation of two-step necessity is claimed.

claims.paper_claim: TREC reports all 36 partial means and four native means; the family has 11 positive, 19 unresolved and zero negative intervals. E5 gains against ridge and Converter persist across all budgets; all six Procrustes point differences are negative.
claims.details: E5 Converter deltas at 25/50/75% are 0.25723359077319435, 0.23138457517015265 and 0.1999540966512042. The abstract range 0.2000-0.2572 rounds correctly. The 25% interval [0.17573076152800798,0.33756850203860655] matches the prose. The family has five Converter, four ridge and two SimpleLinear improvements. All Procrustes and LA2M intervals are unresolved, and negative point differences are retained.

claims.paper_claim: MiniLM at 75% reaches 0.5195 versus native Full-Y 0.5203, with no equivalence inference.
claims.details: The paper explicitly states adapter family does not establish Full-Y equivalence.

claims.paper_claim: Complete matched-FiQA 50% fixed and all-paid means, and all declared 32-family comparisons, are presented for both migrations.
claims.details: MiniLM all-paid ARC2 is 0.36714602143626496, versus fixed 0.3075048582716371; it beats four all-paid baselines and is unresolved against ridge. E5 all-paid is 0.29186698206096195, versus fixed 0.3116352075358866: Procrustes and LA2M comparisons are negative, SimpleLinear and ridge comparisons are positive, and Converter is unresolved. Fixed MiniLM ARC2 trails all five all-paid baselines. E5 within-method delta is -0.019768225474924635 with interval [-0.056329874306672884,0.016636927373489714]. The summed-objective lambda=10 caveat accurately states that effective regularization changes with supervision size.

claims.paper_claim: After true-vector replacement, all-paid E5 nDCG, Recall and paid top-10 share decrease; MiniLM nDCG increases.
claims.details: E5 nDCG is 0.31490775036459107 -> 0.29186698206096207; Recall is 0.6541642457542457 -> 0.5594899234099234; paid top-10 share is 0.49164 -> 0.06472000000000001. MiniLM nDCG is 0.3509507352060274 -> 0.36714602143626507. These are descriptive diagnostics; the paper does not claim they prove causal miscalibration.

claims.paper_claim: Every partial development five-seed ARC2 condition mean is below native Full-X.
claims.details: Resolved F01: the original endpoint wording was broader than the valid statement about 24 condition means. The current source and final rebuilt PDF explicitly say five-seed ARC2 condition mean.

claims.paper_claim: HMoE addresses OOD translation, multi-model mixing and chaining through localized experts and target-PCA residual regularization; ARC2 uses two global tangent updates. HMoE is related-work context and is not an evaluated baseline.

primary_text_sections: Section 4: Multi-Model Mixing and Chaining; target PC1/PC2 residual channels

claims.details: The primary PMLR page was independently opened. Cached primary text supports target principal directions, localized experts and multi-hop scope. Tangent planes at current predictions versus shared target-PCA channels is a faithful distinction. Other nearby descriptive claims were spot-traced to primary cached text; no universal priority or novelty guarantee is audited.

claims.paper_claim: Empirical points, intervals and captions agree with scored evidence; the mechanism counts (24 documents, eight anchors, four backfill encodings and 12 true vectors) are explicitly illustrative.
claims.details: All 80 quality CSV rows, including eight native points, agree with raw scored means. All 15 ablation plot values agree. An independent formatter compared 22 generated table rows and 111 displayed numeric cells with raw summaries; remaining ablation and family rows were checked directly. Final empirical figures were viewed in PDF pages 10-12; method math was viewed on page 6. Figure 4 uses different y ranges, as its caption states.

This establishes local packaging, not anonymous public access or clean-machine end-to-end reproduction. Verification completed at 20:11:42.810083 UTC and first label opening occurred at 20:12:17.410541 UTC; seal and lock hashes agree and all 184 endpoint receipts report exact ordered top-100 agreement. The auditor did not reopen qrels or replay retrieval.

unverified_or_readiness_ledger.detail: No anonymous public research-artifact link is provided in the current paper. Local R3 ZIP availability is verified; public download and reviewer access are not.

No training, encoding, retrieval, ranking replay, qrel opening or rescoring occurred. No independent full 20,000-draw metric bootstrap was rerun. B1c/B1M/B1P intervals were compared with saved scored output and implemented construction; 340 TREC interval endpoints were recalculated from saved bootstrap draws, and B1c/B2 RNG index digests were regenerated.
A fresh gpt-6.1-sol/high audit does not constitute cross-family acceptance, independent replication, universal novelty verification or unconditional submission readiness.
